```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Put the country shapes and the travel data into the page as JSON, so the globe
# (plain canvas, no library) can read them. Both stay in editable files:
# world.geojson and travel.json. To add a trip, add one object to "trips" in
# travel.json. A country that is new also goes into one of the "regions" there;
# a country that no region lists is shown under an "Elsewhere" tag.
geo <- paste(readLines("world.geojson", encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "")
trv <- paste(readLines("travel.json", encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "")
cat('\n<script type="application/json" id="geo-data">', geo, '</script>\n', sep = "")
cat('<script type="application/json" id="travel-data">', trv, '</script>\n\n', sep = "")
```

<style>
/* ===== About page: the Adventures globe (.ab-*). Everything else uses the shared classes in

.ab { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px clamp(28px, 5vw, 72px); min-width: 0; }
.ab-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 0 20px; min-width: 0; }
.ab-regions { gap: 0 8px; }  /* one line that scrolls sideways on phones: the .scroll-x class in the markup */
.ab-region { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 32px; margin: 6px 0; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ne-bg); color: var(--ne-fg); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; }
.ab-region::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -6px 0; }  /* 44px touch target */

.ab-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }

.ab.is-awake .ab-stage { border-color: var(--ink); }  /* awake: the globe keeps every swipe */
.ab-frame { position: relative; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 1; touch-action: pan-y; -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
@supports not (aspect-ratio: 1) { .ab-frame { height: 0; padding-bottom: 100%; } }
.ab-frame canvas { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
/* keyboard focus: the ring goes inside, because these boxes touch their neighbours. On the frame
   it is a box on top of the canvas (an outline would be painted under the canvas). */
.ab-frame:focus-visible { outline: 0; }
.ab-frame:focus-visible::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 4px; border: 1.5px solid var(--brand); pointer-events: none; }
.ab-ctrl button:focus-visible { outline-offset: -4px; }
@media (hover: hover) {

}
.ab-halo { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 0; height: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.ab-halo::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -7px; top: -7px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--te); opacity: 0; animation: ab-halo 2.6s var(--ease) infinite; }
.ab-halo.off::after, .ab.is-away .ab-halo::after { animation: none; }  /* home is on the far side, or the globe is off screen: no pulse */
@keyframes ab-halo { 0% { transform: scale(.7); opacity: .5; } 70% { opacity: 0; } 100% { transform: scale(2.8); opacity: 0; } }
.ab-hint { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: max-content; max-width: calc(100% - 28px); padding: 9px 15px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; text-align: center; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .25s var(--ease); }
.ab-hint.on { opacity: .94; }

.ab-bar { display: flex; align-items: stretch; border-top: 1px solid var(--hair); min-height: 44px; }

/* The lines for this kind of device share one cell and only one shows. The cell is as tall as

.ab-how > span { grid-area: 1 / 1; visibility: hidden; }
.ab-how .t, .ab-how .a { display: none; }

@media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {

}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {

}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .ab { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 540px) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: start; }

/* full screen: the whole component moves into a <dialog>, which sits above everything */
dialog.ab-full { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; max-width: none; max-height: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); overflow: hidden; }

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# Research funding, straight from the `grants` tab of the Google Sheet through
# the shared data layer (R/site-data.R). The CV reads the same tab with the same
# cleaning step (grants_clean), so the total and every amount match the CV.
# Newest grants first. The first `n_first` rows show at once; the rest open in
# place with the "See all" button (the .more block in _theme/theme.scss).
source("../R/site-data.R")
g <- site_grants()
if (is.null(g$rows))
  stop("No funding data yet. Run  Rscript R/update-data.R  from the project root.")
n_first <- 3

d   <- g$rows
yrs <- regmatches(as.character(d$period), gregexpr("[0-9]{4}", as.character(d$period)))
end <- vapply(yrs, function(x) if (length(x)) max(as.numeric(x)) else NA_real_, numeric(1))
beg <- vapply(yrs, function(x) if (length(x)) min(as.numeric(x)) else NA_real_, numeric(1))
d   <- d[order(-end, -beg, -d$budget), , drop = FALSE]      # latest end year, then latest start, then size

roles <- c("PI" = "Principal investigator", "Co-PI" = "Co-principal investigator", "Co-I" = "Co-investigator")
role  <- ifelse(d$my_role %in% names(roles), roles[as.character(d$my_role)], as.character(d$my_role))
rows  <- sprintf(paste0(
  '        <div class="pg-row">\n',
  '          <span class="r-years">%s</span>\n',
  '          <span class="r-title">%s</span>\n',
  '          <span class="r-detail">%s<small>%s</small></span>\n',
  '          <span class="r-amt">%s</span>\n',
  '        </div>'),
  esc(d$period), md_inline(d$title), esc(role), md_inline(d$sponsor), usd(d$budget))

n      <- length(rows)
n_more <- max(0, n - n_first)
first  <- paste(rows[seq_len(min(n, n_first))], collapse = "\n")
more   <- if (n_more > 0) sprintf(paste0(
  '\n        <div class="pg-rows pg-rows--amt more__rows" id="funding-more" hidden>\n%s\n        </div>\n',
  '        <button class="more__btn" type="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="funding-more" ',
  'data-open="See all %d grants" data-close="Show fewer grants">\n',
  '          <span class="more__label">See all %d grants</span>\n',
  '          <span class="more__note">%d earlier %s</span>\n',
  '          <svg class="more__icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path class="v" d="M12 5v14"/></svg>\n',
  '        </button>'),
  paste(rows[(n_first + 1):n], collapse = "\n"), n, n, n_more, if (n_more == 1) "grant" else "grants") else ""

cat(sprintf(paste0(
  '```{=html}\n',
  '  <section class="pg-part hue-cy pg-part--split" id="funding">\n',
  '    <div class="pg-part__head">\n',
  '      <div class="pg-part__name"><span class="pg-num">04</span><h2 class="pg-sectitle">Research funding</h2></div>\n',
  '      <span class="pg-secsub">%d %s</span>\n',
  '    </div>\n',
  '    <div class="pg-part__body">\n',
  '      <div class="fig"><span class="fig-num">%s</span><span class="fig-label">in research funding%s</span></div>\n',
  '      <div class="more">\n',
  '        <div class="pg-rows pg-rows--amt">\n%s\n        </div>%s\n',
  '      </div>\n',
  '    </div>\n',
  '  </section>\n',
  '```\n'),
  n, if (n == 1) "grant" else "grants",
  usd(g$total), if (is.na(g$since)) "" else paste(" since", g$since),
  first, more))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# Honours, straight from the `awards` tab of the Google Sheet through the shared
# data layer (R/site-data.R). The CV reads the same tab with the same cleaning
# step (awards_clean), so both list the same awards in the same order.
# In the Sheet, `description` is "Name of the award, who gave it": the text up
# to the first comma is the title of the row and the rest is the detail (the CV
# sets the same part in bold). `note` adds one more sentence in grey.
# The links under a row are not typed in the Sheet. A row with an `id` gets a
# "Certificate" link when img/awards/<id>-certificate.jpg exists, and a "Photo"
# link when img/awards/<id>-photo.jpg exists (award_files in R/site-data.R).
# Several files of one kind carry a label, <id>-certificate-2013-14.jpg, and
# each gets its own link.
# `url` adds a link to a page about the award on another site.
source("../R/site-data.R")
a <- site_awards()
if (is.null(a) || nrow(a) == 0)
  stop("No awards data yet. Run  Rscript R/update-data.R  from the project root.")

# The rows and their links come from award_rows_html() in R/site-data.R. Home calls the
# same function, so an award reads the same on both pages. A link to a picture opens in
# the picture viewer on this page (data-lb, script in _theme/site.html).
rows <- award_rows_html(a, up = "../")                                        # "../": from this page to the project root

n <- nrow(a)
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  '```{=html}\n',
  '  <section class="pg-part hue-in pg-part--split" id="honours">\n',
  '    <div class="pg-part__head">\n',
  '      <div class="pg-part__name"><span class="pg-num">05</span><h2 class="pg-sectitle">Honours</h2></div>\n',
  '      <span class="pg-secsub">%d %s</span>\n',
  '    </div>\n',
  '    <div class="pg-part__body">\n',
  '      <div class="pg-rows pg-rows--dated">\n%s\n      </div>\n',
  '    </div>\n',
  '  </section>\n',
  '```\n'),
  n, if (n == 1) "award" else "awards", paste(rows, collapse = "\n")))
```

    <p class="panel__text">I'm a regular guy from a developing country, where going abroad once felt like a dream. Research changed that. Every highlighted country is a conference, workshop, or collaboration the work has taken me to. Turn the globe, or pick a region.</p>

        <div class="ab-regions scroll-x" id="ab-regions" role="group" aria-label="Regions"></div>
        <div class="ab-legend"><span><i class="v"></i>Visited</span><span><i class="h"></i>Home</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="ab-stage">
        <div class="ab-frame" tabindex="0" role="group" aria-label="Globe of the countries I have visited. Arrow keys turn it, plus and minus zoom, zero resets. The buttons above choose a region.">
          <canvas aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
          <span class="ab-halo" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span class="ab-hint" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="ab-bar">
          <p class="ab-how"><span class="t">Swipe sideways, or press and hold, to move it.</span><span class="a">It follows your finger now. A quick stroke still scrolls the page.</span><span class="m">Drag to turn it. Hold <span class="ab-key">Ctrl</span> and scroll to zoom.</span><span class="f">Drag in any direction. Pinch or scroll to zoom.</span></p>
          <div class="ab-ctrl">
            <button type="button" data-act="in" aria-label="Zoom in"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></button>
            <button type="button" data-act="out" aria-label="Zoom out"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 10h12"/></svg></button>
            <button type="button" data-act="full" aria-label="Full screen"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 3H3v4M13 3h4v4M17 13v4h-4M3 13v4h4"/></svg></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ab-detail"><noscript>The globe and the list of trips need JavaScript.</noscript></div>
      <p class="visually-hidden" id="ab-say" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
  </section>
  <nav class="pg-next hue-in" aria-label="Next page">
    <a href="../research/index.html">
      <span class="nx-main"><span class="nx-label">Next page</span><span class="nx-title">Research</span></span>
      <span class="nx-text">Vaccination and population immunity, turning routine data into models of outbreak risk.</span>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17L17 7M8 7h9v9"/></svg>
    </a>
  </nav>
</div>

<script>
/* ---- Adventures globe ----
   Plain canvas, no library. Data: world.geojson (country shapes) and travel.json (home, regions,
   trips), both put into the page by the R chunk at the top. How it behaves, and why, is written
   down in STYLE-GUIDE.md under "The About globe". */
(function () {
'use strict';
var el = document.getElementById('ab-globe'), geoEl = document.getElementById('geo-data'), trvEl = document.getElementById('travel-data');
if (!el || !geoEl || !trvEl || !el.querySelector('canvas').getContext) return;

/* ---------- small helpers ---------- */
var root = document.documentElement;
function $(s, e) { return (e || document).querySelector(s); }
function $$(s, e) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((e || document).querySelectorAll(s)); }
function clamp(v, a, b) { return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v)); }
function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]; }); }
function plural(n, one, many) { return n + ' ' + (n === 1 ? one : many); }
function span(a, b, sep) { return a === b ? String(a) : a + sep + b; }
var RAD = Math.PI / 180, TAU = Math.PI * 2;
var calm = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
// move the page at once, with no animation (the theme scrolls smoothly by default)
function jump(top) { try { window.scrollTo({ top: top, behavior: 'instant' }); } catch (e) { window.scrollTo(0, top); } }
var isMac = /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform || '');
// A place on the globe is kept as a point on a sphere of radius 1: [x, y, z].
function unit(ll) { var l = ll[0] * RAD, p = ll[1] * RAD, c = Math.cos(p); return [c * Math.cos(l), c * Math.sin(l), Math.sin(p)]; }
function dot(a, b) { return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]; }
function angle(a, b) { return Math.acos(clamp(dot(a, b), -1, 1)); }                 // between two such points, in radians
function between(a, b, t) {                                                        // the point a share t of the way from a to b, along the globe
  var w = angle(a, b), s = Math.sin(w), p, q;
  if (s < 1e-9) return a;
  p = Math.sin((1 - t) * w) / s; q = Math.sin(t * w) / s;
  return [a[0] * p + b[0] * q, a[1] * p + b[1] * q, a[2] * p + b[2] * q];
}

// the site's one easing curve, cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1), as a function
var EASE = (function (x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  var cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx, cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by;
  return function (x) {
    var t = x, i, d, s;
    for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) { d = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-4) break; s = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(s) < 1e-6) break; t -= d / s; }
    return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t;
  };
})(.22, .61, .36, 1);

// colours come from the CSS tokens, read once per theme
var COL = null;
function colours() {
  if (COL) return COL;
  var s = getComputedStyle(root), g = function (n) { return s.getPropertyValue(n).trim(); };
  COL = { bg: g('--bg'), ink: g('--ink'), muted: g('--muted'), hair: g('--hair'), land: g('--land'), bl: g('--bl'), blFg: g('--bl-fg'), ind: g('--in'), te: g('--te'), teFg: g('--te-fg') };
  return COL;
}

/* ---------- data: places, cities, trips and regions ---------- */
function makeData(T) {
  var HOME = { iso3: T.home.iso3, name: T.home.country, city: T.home.city, ll: [T.home.coords[1], T.home.coords[0]], note: T.home.note };
  var TRIPS = T.trips.map(function (t, i) { return { country: t.country, iso3: t.iso3, city: t.city, year: t.year, event: t.event, ll: [t.coords[1], t.coords[0]], i: i }; });
  TRIPS.sort(function (a, b) { return b.year - a.year || a.i - b.i; });            // newest first; the file order decides inside a year
  var PLACES = {}, CITIES = [], REGIONS = [], used = {};
  PLACES[HOME.iso3] = { iso3: HOME.iso3, name: HOME.name, home: true, trips: [], cities: [{ city: HOME.city, ll: HOME.ll, u: unit(HOME.ll), iso3: HOME.iso3, home: true, n: 0 }] };
  TRIPS.forEach(function (t) {
    var p = PLACES[t.iso3] || (PLACES[t.iso3] = { iso3: t.iso3, name: t.country, home: false, trips: [], cities: [] }), c = null;
    p.trips.push(t);
    p.cities.forEach(function (x) { if (x.city === t.city) c = x; });
    if (!c) p.cities.push(c = { city: t.city, ll: t.ll, u: unit(t.ll), iso3: t.iso3, home: !!p.home && t.city === HOME.city, n: 0 });
    c.n++;
  });
  Object.keys(PLACES).forEach(function (k) {
    var p = PLACES[k], best = p.cities[0];
    p.cities.forEach(function (c) { if (c.n > best.n) best = c; });               // the country's dot while zoomed out: its most visited city
    best.main = true;
    if (p.trips.length) { p.y0 = Math.min.apply(null, p.trips.map(function (t) { return t.year; })); p.y1 = Math.max.apply(null, p.trips.map(function (t) { return t.year; })); }
    CITIES = CITIES.concat(p.cities);
  });
  var visited = Object.keys(PLACES).filter(function (k) { return !PLACES[k].home; });
  var byTrips = function (a, b) { return PLACES[b].trips.length - PLACES[a].trips.length || PLACES[a].name.localeCompare(PLACES[b].name); };
  (T.regions || []).forEach(function (r) {
    var isos = r.countries.filter(function (i) { return PLACES[i] && !PLACES[i].home && !used[i]; });
    isos.forEach(function (i) { used[i] = 1; });
    if (isos.length) REGIONS.push({ name: r.name, isos: isos.sort(byTrips) });
  });
  var rest = visited.filter(function (i) { return !used[i]; });                     // a country that no region lists still gets a tag
  if (rest.length) REGIONS.push({ name: REGIONS.length ? 'Elsewhere' : 'All places', isos: rest.sort(byTrips) });
  REGIONS.forEach(function (r) {
    r.n = 0; r.y0 = 9999; r.y1 = 0;
    r.isos.forEach(function (i) { var p = PLACES[i]; p.region = r.name; r.n += p.trips.length; r.y0 = Math.min(r.y0, p.y0); r.y1 = Math.max(r.y1, p.y1); });
  });
  return { HOME: HOME, TRIPS: TRIPS, PLACES: PLACES, CITIES: CITIES, REGIONS: REGIONS, isos: Object.keys(PLACES), nCountries: visited.length, y0: TRIPS.length ? TRIPS[TRIPS.length - 1].year : 0, y1: TRIPS.length ? TRIPS[0].year : 0 };
}
// the smallest circle on the globe that holds a set of points: its centre and its radius in degrees
function capOf(us) {
  var c = [0, 0, 0], n, i, j, far, fd, d, rad = 0;
  us.forEach(function (u) { c[0] += u[0]; c[1] += u[1]; c[2] += u[2]; });
  n = Math.hypot(c[0], c[1], c[2]) || 1; c = [c[0] / n, c[1] / n, c[2] / n];
  for (i = 1; i <= 120; i++) {
    fd = 2; far = us[0];
    for (j = 0; j < us.length; j++) { d = dot(c, us[j]); if (d < fd) { fd = d; far = us[j]; } }
    c = [c[0] + (far[0] - c[0]) / (i + 1), c[1] + (far[1] - c[1]) / (i + 1), c[2] + (far[2] - c[2]) / (i + 1)];
    n = Math.hypot(c[0], c[1], c[2]) || 1; c = [c[0] / n, c[1] / n, c[2] / n];
  }
  us.forEach(function (u) { rad = Math.max(rad, angle(c, u)); });
  return { cen: [Math.atan2(c[1], c[0]) / RAD, Math.asin(clamp(c[2], -1, 1)) / RAD], rad: rad / RAD, u: c };
}
// what to frame for each country, each region and the whole world
function setFocus(D, shapes) {
  Object.keys(D.PLACES).forEach(function (iso) {
    var p = D.PLACES[iso], polys = shapes[iso], us = p.cities.map(function (c) { return c.u; });
    if (polys) {
      // The pieces of the country near the cities I went to. This leaves out far territories
      // (French Guiana, Alaska), which would pull the view to the wrong place.
      var rings = polys.map(function (poly) { return poly[0].map(unit); });
      var near = rings.filter(function (ring) { return ring.some(function (v) { return p.cities.some(function (c) { return angle(v, c.u) < 6 * RAD; }); }); });
      (near.length ? near : rings).forEach(function (ring) { us = us.concat(ring); });
    }
    p.us = us; p.focus = capOf(us);
  });
  var home = D.PLACES[D.HOME.iso3];
  D.REGIONS.forEach(function (r) {
    var us = [];
    r.isos.forEach(function (i) { us = us.concat(D.PLACES[i].us); });
    var c = capOf(us);
    if (angle(c.u, home.cities[0].u) < (c.rad + 12) * RAD) c = capOf(us.concat(home.us));   // home is next door: keep it in the picture
    r.focus = c;
  });
  // "World": face the middle of the places I have been (the mean direction of the cities), with
  // the centre kept between the equator and 45 degrees north so the globe looks the usual way up.
  var m = [0, 0, 0];
  D.CITIES.forEach(function (c) { m[0] += c.u[0]; m[1] += c.u[1]; m[2] += c.u[2]; });
  D.start = { lam: Math.atan2(m[1], m[0]) / RAD, phi: clamp(Math.atan2(m[2], Math.hypot(m[0], m[1])) / RAD, 0, 45), k: 1 };
}

/* ---------- the shapes, stored once as points on the sphere ----------
   A frame is then one 3 x 3 rotation per point, with no map library in the way. Each shape also
   carries the small circle that holds it, so a shape on the far side, or off the canvas when
   zoomed in, is skipped without looking at its points. Large shapes get a second, lighter copy
   (every second corner) for the frames in which the globe turns fast. */
function sphereRings(shapes) {
  var pack = function (us, closed) {
    var out = [], n = us.length, i, j, a, b, w, steps;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      a = us[i]; out.push(a);
      if (!closed && i === n - 1) break;
      b = us[(i + 1) % n]; w = angle(a, b);
      if (w > 3 * RAD) { steps = Math.ceil(w / (2.5 * RAD)); for (j = 1; j < steps; j++) out.push(between(a, b, j / steps)); }   // long edges follow the curve of the globe
    }
    var f = new Float32Array(out.length * 3), c = capOf(out), sr = c.rad >= 89 ? 2 : Math.sin(c.rad * RAD), lo = f, ln = out.length;
    out.forEach(function (v, k) { f[3 * k] = v[0]; f[3 * k + 1] = v[1]; f[3 * k + 2] = v[2]; });
    if (closed && out.length >= 24) {
      ln = Math.ceil(out.length / 2); lo = new Float32Array(ln * 3);
      for (i = 0; i < ln; i++) { lo[3 * i] = f[6 * i]; lo[3 * i + 1] = f[6 * i + 1]; lo[3 * i + 2] = f[6 * i + 2]; }
    }
    return { p: f, n: out.length, lo: lo, ln: ln, s: new Float32Array(out.length * 3), cx: c.u[0], cy: c.u[1], cz: c.u[2], sr: sr };
  };
  // The corners of a ring as points on the globe, each once (the file repeats the first corner at
  // the end). A file made for flat maps also cuts Antarctica open: its ring runs along the bottom
  // edge of the map (latitude -90) and up and down the 180 degree line. On a globe the bottom edge
  // is one point, the pole, and the cut is a line that goes out and straight back. Both are left
  // out here, or the cut would be drawn as a border across the ice.
  var same = function (a, b) { return angle(a, b) < 1e-6; };
  var onGlobe = function (ring) {
    var us = [];
    ring.forEach(function (p) {
      if (Math.abs(p[1]) > 89.9) return;                                            // the pole
      var u = unit(p), n = us.length;
      if (n && same(us[n - 1], u)) return;                                          // the same place twice in a row
      if (n > 1 && same(us[n - 2], u)) { us.pop(); return; }                        // out and straight back
      us.push(u);
    });
    // the ring is a loop, so the same two checks where its end meets its start
    while (us.length > 1 && same(us[0], us[us.length - 1])) us.pop();
    while (us.length > 2 && same(us[1], us[us.length - 1])) { us.shift(); us.pop(); }
    while (us.length > 2 && same(us[0], us[us.length - 2])) { us.pop(); us.pop(); }
    return us;
  };
  var G = { land: [], iso: {}, grat: [] }, lon, lat, line;
  Object.keys(shapes).forEach(function (iso) {
    var mine = G.iso[iso] = [];
    shapes[iso].forEach(function (poly) { poly.forEach(function (ring) { var us = onGlobe(ring), r; if (us.length < 3) return; r = pack(us, true); G.land.push(r); mine.push(r); }); });
  });
  for (lon = -180; lon < 180; lon += 10) { line = []; for (lat = -80; lat <= 80; lat += 5) line.push(unit([lon, lat])); G.grat.push(pack(line, false)); }
  for (lat = -80; lat <= 80; lat += 10) { line = []; for (lon = -180; lon <= 180; lon += 5) line.push(unit([lon, lat])); G.grat.push(pack(line, false)); }
  return G;
}

/* ---------- drawing helpers ---------- */
var FONT = '500 12.5px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif';
// the dots fade out as they near the edge of the globe, so they do not pop in and out
function drawDots(ctx, c, pts, r) {
  pts.forEach(function (p) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = p.a;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.on ? r + 1 : r, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.on ? (p.home ? c.teFg : c.blFg) : c.bg; ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = p.on ? c.bg : (p.home ? c.teFg : c.blFg); ctx.stroke();
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}
// names next to their dots. A name goes to the left when another dot sits just to its right.
function drawLabels(ctx, c, pts, w) {
  ctx.font = FONT; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  pts.forEach(function (p) {
    var tw = ctx.measureText(p.text).width, left = p.x + tw + 16 > w || pts.some(function (q) { return q !== p && Math.abs(q.y - p.y) < 15 && q.x > p.x && q.x - p.x < tw + 22; });
    var x = p.x + (left ? -11 : 11);
    ctx.textAlign = left ? 'right' : 'left';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.strokeStyle = c.bg; ctx.strokeText(p.text, x, p.y + .5);
    ctx.fillStyle = c.ink; ctx.fillText(p.text, x, p.y + .5);
  });
}
// Which place did a tap mean? One country near the finger: that country. Two or more countries
// within reach and no clear winner: a "cluster", and the caller zooms in so they come apart.
function pickCity(pts, x, y, touch) {
  var R = touch ? 24 : 11;
  var near = pts.map(function (p) { return { p: p, d: Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y) }; }).filter(function (o) { return o.d < R; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.d - b.d; });
  if (!near.length) return null;
  var other = null, i;
  for (i = 1; i < near.length; i++) if (near[i].p.iso3 !== near[0].p.iso3) { other = near[i]; break; }
  if (!other || near[0].d < other.d * .55) return { iso: near[0].p.iso3 };
  return { iso: near[0].p.iso3, cluster: pts.filter(function (p) { return Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y) < R * 1.7; }) };
}

/* ============================================================
   Gestures: touch, mouse, wheel and trackpad, turned into a few plain calls.
   Touch rules while the globe sits in the page and is "asleep" (nobody is using it):
     one finger that starts sideways        takes the globe (grab, move, release)
     one finger that rests, then moves      takes the globe too (press and hold)
     one finger that starts up or down      is left to the browser: the page scrolls
     two fingers                            pinch (zoom and turn), or a two-finger tap
   Once a finger has taken the globe it is "awake" (h.free() is true) and every one-finger swipe
   moves it, in any direction. The globe decides when it sleeps again. Full screen is always free.
   ============================================================ */
function Gestures(el, h) {
  var mode = null, lock = null, sx = 0, sy = 0, rect = null, quiet = false, d0 = 1, m0 = null, t2 = 0, still = true;
  var t0 = 0, wasFree = false, vert = false, held = false, press = 0, lx = 0, ly = 0, lt = 0, sp = 0, vy = 0;
  var lastTap = -1e9, tx = 0, ty = 0, touchAt = -1e9, drag = null, gs = 1, liveAt = -1e9;
  function box() { rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); }      // measured once per gesture, not once per move

  function two(e) { var a = at(e.touches[0]), b = at(e.touches[1]); return { d: Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]) || 1, m: [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2] }; }

    if (e.touches.length === 1) {

      t0 = e.timeStamp; wasFree = h.free(); held = false; clearTimeout(press);
      // press and hold: a finger that rests on the globe for a moment takes it, whichever way it then moves
      if (!wasFree) press = setTimeout(function () { if (mode === 'one' && !lock) { held = true; h.pressed(); } }, 200);
    } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
      clearTimeout(press);
      if (mode === 'one' && lock === 'grab') h.release(e.timeStamp, true, null);
      var t = two(e); mode = 'two'; quiet = true; still = true; d0 = t.d; m0 = t.m; t2 = e.timeStamp; h.stop();
    }

      var t = two(e);

        if (Math.abs(t.d - d0) < 8 && Math.hypot(t.m[0] - m0[0], t.m[1] - m0[1]) < 8) return;
        still = false; d0 = t.d; m0 = t.m; h.pinchStart(t.m[0], t.m[1]); return;
      }
      h.pinch(t.d / d0, t.m[0], t.m[1]); return;
    }
    if (mode !== 'one' || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    var p = at(e.touches[0]);
    if (!lock) {
      var dx = p[0] - sx, dy = p[1] - sy;
      if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 9) return;
      clearTimeout(press); quiet = true; vert = Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx);
      // The globe takes this finger when it is awake, when the finger pressed and held, or when
      // the swipe is sideways (within about 56 degrees of sideways).
      var mine = h.free() || held || Math.abs(dy) < Math.abs(dx) * 1.5;
      if (mine && !h.free() && !e.cancelable) mine = false;      // the browser has already started to scroll the page: leave it
      lock = mine ? 'grab' : 'page';
      if (mine) { e.preventDefault(); h.stop(); h.grab(p[0], p[1], e.timeStamp, true); lx = p[0]; ly = p[1]; lt = e.timeStamp; sp = vy = 0; }
      else if (held) h.missed();
      return;
    }
    if (lock === 'grab') {
      if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
      var dt = Math.max(1, e.timeStamp - lt); sp = .6 * Math.hypot(p[0] - lx, p[1] - ly) / dt + .4 * sp; vy = .6 * (p[1] - ly) / dt + .4 * vy; lx = p[0]; ly = p[1]; lt = e.timeStamp;   // finger speed, in pixels per ms

      if (e.touches.length === 1 && !still) { var p = at(e.touches[0]); mode = 'one'; lock = 'grab'; vert = false; h.grab(p[0], p[1], e.timeStamp, true); lx = p[0]; ly = p[1]; lt = e.timeStamp; sp = vy = 0; }   // one finger stays down: it keeps hold of the globe
      else mode = e.touches.length ? 'rest' : null;
